changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE orders ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), stripe_checkout_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, heygen_video_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, santa_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, message VARCHAR(1500) NOT NULL, message_size INTEGER NOT NULL, locale VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );
